method: Sales added = a shop's public Etsy sales counter on 2026-11-04 minus the same counter 1 day(s) earlier, both read exactly on those dates. No scaling. Shops without both reads, with rounded counters, a counter that went down, or an implausible jump are left out.
niche_method: Niche = the shop's Etsy category. Sales added in a niche = the sum of sales added by its shops over the same 2-day exact counter pairs (no scaling). A niche is ranked only with at least 10 shops with clean reads and when no single shop makes up more than 50% of its sales added.
